notes: Telescope: pinch/wheel narrows the sky from 50° to 18″ with level of detail (baked H144 glass → live grid → flower-of-life sublevels). The cell readout is engraved on the glass beside the selected cell; tap again to clear. Pre-render: the H144 grid is baked once into a cube map (bake status in debug).

apk.notes: Offline shelf: Shelf › Download all puts the 30 public-domain books (1.49 GB) on your phone — pause, resume, delete, storage meter; books read with no network (airplane mode). Import your own PDFs privately (＋ Import PDF; stays on this phone).
